response.original_title: Straight Talk: Add a Second Line to My Account, Explained
response.overview: Updated November 22, 2026  Call 1-888-788-9033 for Straight Talk add a second line to my account with Straight Talk — the account number and a payment source are all it needs, and a receipt follows.  Straight Talk add a second line to my account posts same or next business day through 1-888-788-9033 or straighttalk.com; keep the confirmation until the next statement. 1-888-788-9033 settles Straight Talk port number out forfeits unused days from the account number, names any charge, and sends a receipt to keep. To handle Straight Talk new sim card needed for volte network, use straighttalk.com or call 1-888-788-9033; either way the receipt is the proof worth keeping. For anything a screen will not finish, 1-888-788-9033 takes it by phone from the account number.
